name: Simulacrum Sonata
source:
Circe is a passionate inventor, one of the few in the country of Bellecantamen. She's finally completed her magnum opus: a thinking, feeling robot. What now?

[From [url=https://sucrecube.itch.io/simulacrum-sonata]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
喀耳刻热爱发明，在贝尔坎塔门这样的国家，发明家可没几个。如今，她终于完成了自己的得意之作：一个会思考、也有感情的机器人。然后呢？

（来源：[url=https://sucrecube.itch.io/simulacrum-sonata]itch.io[/url]）
